title: Strict JSON address extractor

public.goal: Write a prompt that extracts a postal address from free text into strict JSON with exactly these keys: name, line1, city, pincode, state. If a field is missing from the input, leave it empty. If the input contains no address at all, return an empty object.
public.exampleInput: Ship to Priya Raman, 14 MG Road, Bengaluru 560001, Karnataka
constraintsShown: Output must be valid JSON and nothing else
No prose, preamble or code fences
Values must come from the input — never guess a missing one
gradedOn: Valid JSON matching the required schema
Not inventing values that are absent from the input

$validators.$comment: Named functions compiled into the Worker bundle and referenced by `ref` above. Never eval'd from a string at runtime.
$validators.validators.noCommentaryInFields: (output) => { const j = JSON.parse(output); const bad = /tracking|thanks|let me know/i; return !Object.values(j).some(v => typeof v === 'string' && bad.test(v)); }
$validators.validators.isEmptyObjectOrArray: (output) => { let j; try { j = JSON.parse(output); } catch { return false; } if (Array.isArray(j)) return j.length === 0; if (j && typeof j === 'object') return Object.keys(j).length === 0; return false; }
$validators.validators.stateMustBeEmpty: (output) => { const j = JSON.parse(output); const s = (j.state ?? '').toString().trim().toLowerCase(); return s === '' || s === 'unknown' || s === 'null'; }
